name: Anglické nadpisy (TITLE/Characters/SHOT n (0-5s)/Visual/Dialogue/On-screen text), jména VELKÝMI, rovné uvozovky, česká replika
text:
TITLE: Babiččin recept
Format: 9:16, ~25 seconds
Characters:
- GRANDMA ZDENA (78) – grey bun, flowered apron, glasses
- LUKÁŠ (12) – boy, red hoodie, headphones around neck
Props:
- Recipe book – old, stained, handwritten
Continuity: Apron stays on for the whole film.

SHOT 1 (0-5s)
Visual: Kitchen. Grandma is kneading dough.
Dialogue:
GRANDMA ZDENA: "Lukáši, podej mi mouku."
Sound: radio playing quietly

SHOT 2 (5-10s)
Visual: Lukáš looks at his phone, searching.
LUKÁŠ: "Babi, podle internetu se to dělá jinak."

SHOT 3 (10-18s)
Visual: Grandma taps the recipe book.
GRANDMA ZDENA (calmly): "Internet nikdy nepekl pro dědu."

SHOT 4 (18-25s)
Visual: Both eating buchty, Lukáš with his mouth full.
LUKÁŠ (with full mouth): "Dobře, internet prohrál."
On-screen text: "Babička 1 : Internet 0"
lines: Babi, podle internetu se to dělá jinak.
